steps.code:
This WordPress site was built by a Blueprint in your browser. Pick a project to open its demo or source in a new tab.

Shared PHP tools

These projects use PHP.wasm packages maintained by WordPress Playground.

  • Joomla Open the CMS that Herman Peeren brought to the browser.
  • Silverstripe Explore the page tree in Andy Adiwidjaja’s CMS prototype.
  • Laravel Edit a route or a Blade view in Andrew Schmelyun’s Liminal IDE. Liminal source
  • Moodle Explore course provisioning in a browser-based learning platform.
  • Shopware Try a storefront backed by MariaDB in WebAssembly.
  • Omeka S Explore the software that museums use to build digital collections.
  • Nextcloud Try the file-sharing and collaboration platform.
  • FacturaScripts Explore invoicing and business management.
  • PortalDots Explore the Laravel prototype for managing school festivals. The source includes a PHP worker and SQLite setup.

Built on Playground

One team runs a PHP app directly in Playground. Another adapted Playground for its own CMS.

  • Symfony Launch Package Radar from a Blueprint that boots Symfony directly.
  • TYPO3 Read Macopedia’s proof of concept. The hosted demo currently requires sign-in.

Playground in Python

These teams cite WordPress Playground as inspiration and run Python with Pyodide.

  • Frappe / ERPNext Explore the Frappe framework and its experimental ERPNext app with LUBUS’s Playground.
  • Wagtail / Django Explore Wagtail’s bakery demo, where the CMS runs on Python and SQLite inside the browser.

Other PHP runtimes

These projects use Sean Morris’s PHP-Wasm or PHP-CGI-Wasm toolchain.

  • Drupal Open Matt Glaman’s browser demo of Drupal.
  • Twig Edit a template and see its rendered output.
  • CakePHP Launch the CakePHP 5 example.
  • CodeIgniter Launch the CodeIgniter 4 example.
  • Laminas Launch the Laminas 3 example.
  • BEAR.Sunday Try a to-do application that runs on PHP-CGI-Wasm and SQLite.

Applications and libraries

These tools use Playground’s PHP.wasm packages for specific tasks, from editing a diagram to converting coordinates.

  • BPMN Canvas Model a process in a Laravel application.
  • PHP Arena Run and share a PHP snippet from the editor.
  • BoxPacker Visualize how items fit into a shipping box.
  • PHPCoord Convert coordinates between reference systems.
  • Wizardawn Try the PHP generators for tabletop role-playing games. Wizardawn source
  • CodeCompared Explore the same programming examples across languages. Its PHP runtime uses Playground’s PHP.wasm packages.
  • PHP Scholar Explore Fellyph Cintra’s source for a browser-based PHP exercise environment.
